channel.description: Channel service (pub/sub messaging, channel subscriptions, announce-only enforcement)
channel._comment_admin_handler: When true, ChannelAdminHandler is registered alongside the subscription handler. The admin handler exposes channel_create / channel_list / channel_set_announce_only / channel_add_announcer / channel_remove_announcer WS verbs. Operators should run 'con channel-*' instead of using these WS verbs directly, but they're useful for in-process admin tools.
channel._comment_auto_seed: Channels seeded at BED startup. The auto_seed list is shared across all modules; each entry's createdby must be namespaced per its owning module (e.g., 'zoid6:casino', 'empyre:router'). Namespaced daemon members are auto-created via bbsengine6.member.lib.register_module_member when they don't exist (warn-and-skip on failure). Seeds are idempotent (skipped when the channel name already exists).

websocket._comment: WebSocket keepalive (seconds), forwarded to websockets.serve(). The websockets library default of 20s/20s is too aggressive for terminal clients (casino_client, etc.) whose main loop interleaves blocking stdin reads — pings go unanswered during those reads, the server hits the 20s timeout, and the next client send gets ConnectionClosedError 1011. 60s/600s gives the operator 10 minutes between actions before the server considers the connection dead.
